sources.title: Avatar: The Way of Water — Deadline profit study, 19 April 2023
sources.facts: About $2.3B gross; $531.7M estimated film profit including home entertainment and streaming/TV; $1.26B film rentals. Not audited theatrical-only profit.

sources.title: The Super Mario Bros Movie — Deadline profit study, 6 May 2024
sources.facts: $1.36B gross; $559M estimated film profit; $100M production. Different costs and downstream revenue from Avatar.

sources.title: Film distribution and cinema operators — UK Cinema Association
sources.facts: Exhibitor/distributor rental terms usually percentage of box office; vary by film and run timing. Cinema uses retained income to operate.

sources.title: Working in distribution — Independent Cinema Office
sources.facts: Film booking agreement sets flat fee or percentage, often combination for independent cinema; terms and duration reflect audience expectations. Not a universal producer-per-show rental rule.

sources.title: The economics of the operation — Independent Cinema Office
sources.facts: Cinema pays film hire; may owe distributor a minimum guarantee. Cinema has its own staffing and premises costs. Do not invert the guarantee direction.

sources.title: Cinemark full-year 2025 results — SEC Exhibit 99.1
sources.facts: Admissions $1544.7M; film rentals and advertising combined $877M; own staffing/lease costs separately reported. Combined expense is not a pure studio take-rate.

sources.title: Disney FY2025 annual report
sources.facts: Theatrical revenue is rentals from films licensed to theaters; TV/VOD and home entertainment revenue are separately described.
